issues.explanation: Chapter 56 ends with Zhou Yu falling from his horse, but Chapter 57 immediately has him continuing the campaign and facing Liu Feng and Guan Ping without saying that his attendants rescue him or that Sun Yu arrives and orders the army onward, as in Source Chapter 57. The transition from apparent incapacitation to active command is abrupt.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief bridge: Zhou Yu is rescued back to his ship; Sun Quan sends Sun Yu to reinforce him, and Zhou Yu orders the army to continue forward.
